Whether it’s complex simulations, scientific measurement series or data-intensive analyses: research generates enormous volumes of data. However, sharing data between research teams and institutions is often hampered by technical obstacles.

The whitepaper shows how the HPC add-on for OpenCloud simplifies access to research data: https://opencloud.eu/en/high-performance-computing
